data.long_meaning: Obadan is a Hebrew name derived from the root words ‘obad’ meaning ‘serve’ and ‘Adon’ meaning ‘God’. It is a name given to those who are devoted to serving and pleasing God. In the Old Testament, Obadiah was a prophet who showed great courage and loyalty to God, even during difficult times. In Christian tradition, the name Obadan symbolizes faith, loyalty, and courage in the service of God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of deep faith and devotion to God.
data.etymology: Obadan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”

in_hebrew.name: עובדן
in_hebrew.meaning: עובד אלוהים משרת ה' נאמן וקדוש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עובדן הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'משרת אלוהים' או 'עובד ה''. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'עובד' שפירושו 'משרת' או 'עובד', ו'אלוהים' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם עובדן מביע את הרעיון של שירות ומסירות לאלוהים, ומשמש כזכר ליחסי הגומלין בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ουαβαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ουαβαν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'δοῦλος τοῦ Θεοῦ' ή 'υπηρέτης του Θεού'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος 'δοῦλος' χρησιμοποιείται συχνά για να περιγράψει τη σχέση μεταξύ του πιστού και του Θεού. Το όνομα Ουαβαν αντανακλά την πνευματική σχέση του ανθρώπου με το Θεό και τη δέσμευσή του να Τον υπηρετεί.

in_latin.name: Obadan
in_latin.long_meaning: Obadan nomen hebraicum est quod significat 'servus Dei' aut 'fidelis Dei'. Compositum est ex duobus verbis: 'servus' quod significat 'servus' vel 'minister', et 'Dei' quod significat 'Deus'. Nomen Obadan exprimit notionem servitii et devotionis ad Deum, et commemorat relationem mutuitatem inter hominem et Deum.

in_english.long_meaning: Obadan is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'servant of God' or 'faithful servant of God'. The name Obadan is composed of two words: 'obed' meaning 'servant' or 'worshipper', and 'Dan' which is a suffix indicating judgment or righteousness. In Christian tradition, the name Obadan signifies a life of devotion, service, and commitment to God. It reflects the biblical concept of servanthood and spiritual leadership. Historically, the name Obadan has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing humility, faithfulness, and spiritual dedication.
